title: Jumping genes (transposons) discovered
place: Cold Spring Harbor, New York, USA
summary: Studying maize, McClintock found that genetic elements can move on the chromosome and switch genes on and off.
why: Showed that genomes are dynamic and regulated.

notes.problem: Source: historian Nathaniel Comfort 'contests the claim that McClintock was marginalized', calling it the 'McClintock Myth'; the unsung framing is disputed.

unsung.contribution: Discovered that genetic elements can transpose and regulate genes.
unsung.recognition: Facing scepticism she stopped publishing her data in 1953; the Nobel came only in 1983.
